doc.title: Billy Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995

title: Filling in with Basie after leaving
summary: He sat in the chair temporarily when Eric or Lockjaw were away.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Low sick. Yeah there’s certainly not the opportunities for young players to learn like they used to I guess. You had a few years in between with Basie. You left and came back?

Well, no it’s not really going back. I would go like if someone asked. For example Eric’s mother was ill so he had to take off, so I’d fill in for him for a couple of weeks. And one time Lockjaw had, but it wasn’t really like I went back to the band, I was just holding the chair until these people got back.
